name: Play QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES policy
plain: Apps that want to list every installed app must justify it to Google.
meaning: Since Android 11 apps see only a filtered set of other apps. QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES gives a full list, so Play requires a declared core purpose such as security, device management or file managers.

android.store_policy: Policy effective 5 Aug 2021; core purpose declaration; alternative <queries> or intent filters
android.api_surface: Play Console > Declaration form; <queries> manifest element
android.note: Installed apps list is a known ads signal; policy limits resale.

ios.note: No installed apps API; probing is limited to declared schemes.

limits.headline: Can see every installed app on Android only if Google approves the reason
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the app asks for the full list in the background
can: List all apps for security, device management or file manager uses, if approved
See a small filtered set of apps on Android 11 and later without approval
Check a few named apps on iPhone, up to 50 link types
cannot: Use the list for ads or resale
Get the full list without a declared main purpose
List apps at all on iPhone
limits.differs: Android has this permission with a Play review. iPhone has no installed app list at all.

story.what_it_is: Google's rule that apps need an approved reason to see every app on your phone.

marketing.name: QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES policy
marketing.pitch: Only apps whose core purpose needs the full list of installed apps may request it.

story.for_you: You never get a prompt. The phone just hides most other apps from every app by default, so a game cannot guess that you have a dating or health app.
story.for_makers: The full list helps with security, device management and some anti fraud. Google makes teams explain the need and prove it, or use narrow package queries instead.

use_cases.example: An antivirus scans the whole device for malware and keeps the right to see all apps.
A work phone management app lists apps to enforce company rules.
A bank asks about a few remote access apps by name and does not request the full list.
A game uses a narrow query to find the publisher's launcher and offers a bonus.
An SDK was caught gathering app lists for interest profiles, a use Play rejects.
A launcher app needs all apps to show them, which Google allows as its core purpose.

story.android_note: Since Android 11 apps see only a filtered set of apps unless approved.
story.ios_note: iOS apps cannot see other apps at all except by checking a few declared schemes.
